description: Shahtaj Sugar Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 27 March 1965 as a public limited company and has been listed since 1972. Its mill at Mandi Bahauddin in Punjab went into commercial production in November 1968 with plant imported from Italy, and crushing capacity has since been raised to between 8,000 and 10,000 metric tons of cane a day. The company manufactures sugar from cane and states that molasses is its only significant by-product.
